scale.ratio: each body's token movement per unit of its own posture movement over the 300-s window (the token's and the posture's standard deviation over time, mean over numbers): 0 = the token does not move with the posture; the line = the live bodies' level
scale.ratio_posture_only: the same with the velocity and capacity inputs held at their window mean: the part that answers the posture (the lesson pushes this one)
scale.engaged: the bodies the lesson pushes: engaged when read under DEAF, released at LINE
scale.pushed_ever: the bodies the lesson has pushed since the start (the hold acts on these only)
scale.fatigue_line: the hold's line in force: the median fatigue answer on the posture-only rows of the judged bodies the lesson never pushed, read at the start and again each window (300 s) (null: no live body at the start, the hold does not act)
scale.fatigue_line_step: the step the hold's line was last read
scale.fatigue_answer_posture_only: the fatigue answer on the posture-only rows: every pushed body's at every step (the hold's reading), every moving body's on a gauge step
scale.hold_share_since_gauge: per body, the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold pulled it down
scale.hold_any_share_since_gauge: the share of the steps since the last gauge step in which the hold acted on any body
scale.held: the pushed bodies whose posture-only fatigue answer read over the fatigue line (the hold pulled them down this step)
scale.hold: 1/2 x the sum of the held bodies' squared log excess over the fatigue line / bodies
scale.shortfall: ln line - ln ratio for a pushed body (0 at or above the line, or not engaged)
scale.jitter_share: the token's share of its own variance that changes between consecutive samples (0 = smooth, 1 = consecutive tokens unrelated)
scale.posture_jitter_share: the same share of the posture itself
scale.content: the version-4 posture content (a ten-block decoder's R2 at the penalty control_lambda): 0 = the token says nothing about the posture, 1 = exactly
scale.content_gain_matched: the same with the token's gain since the start divided out: a pure gain reads the start's content, movement without posture information less
scale.content_control: the same with the tokens shifted 150 s against the posture
scale.fatigue_answer: the token's mean change per number when every fatigue input moves by fatigue_step, over its response: 0 = the token ignores fatigue
scale.held_out: the window read through the encoder saved one window earlier (movement that encoder never trained on): its ratio and gain-matched content
scale.lesson_pace: each body's first-order change of ln ratio per update from the lesson's own step
scale.attributed: the lesson's summed first-order change of each body's ln ratio since the start
scale.start: the readings of the first full window, before the lesson's first update
scale.spread: the token's standard deviation over the 300-s window per number, mean over numbers: 0 = one token every moment
scale.posture_spread: the posture's standard deviation over the window per number, mean over numbers
scale.below_line: bodies pushed at the last step
scale.no_movement: bodies whose posture numbers did not change over the window (no ratio)
scale.applied: the lesson's gradient added after the clip, as a share of each encoder tensor's running gradient size; step_lr: the lesson's step per weight in learning rates

contact_control.gate_world_why: outside touches: 3 of the 32 control moments the gate judges have been measured (a control moment counts when one of the outside touches began on it); it is shut until all 32 are

synergy.command_size_scope: formed proposals; following_by_author grades full executed tenures

liveness.varying_rule: the share of a layer's units whose output range over the window's samples exceeds one bf16 step at the unit's own size and the widest output below the -3 line; not_varying lists layers under half

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 20.7 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31

scale.content_gain_matched: the same with the token's gain since the start divided out: a pure gain reads the start's content, movement without posture information less
scale.content_control: the same with the tokens shifted 150 s against the posture
scale.fatigue_answer: the token's mean change per number when every fatigue input moves by fatigue_step, over its response: 0 = the token ignores fatigue
scale.held_out: the window read through the encoder saved one window earlier (movement that encoder never trained on): its ratio and gain-matched content
scale.lesson_pace: each body's first-order change of ln ratio per update from the lesson's own step
scale.attributed: the lesson's summed first-order change of each body's ln ratio since the start
scale.start: the readings of the first full window, before the lesson's first update
scale.spread: the token's standard deviation over the 300-s window per number, mean over numbers: 0 = one token every moment
scale.posture_spread: the posture's standard deviation over the window per number, mean over numbers
scale.below_line: bodies pushed at the last step
scale.no_movement: bodies whose posture numbers did not change over the window (no ratio)
scale.applied: the lesson's gradient added after the clip, as a share of each encoder tensor's running gradient size; step_lr: the lesson's step per weight in learning rates

hand_descent.nonfinger_orders: retained exactly from the filtered controller
retained exactly from the filtered controller

contact_control.gate_self_why: self-touches: 10 of the 32 control moments the gate judges have been measured (a control moment counts when one of the self-touches began on it); it is shut until all 32 are
contact_control.gate_world_why: outside touches: 14 of the 32 control moments the gate judges have been measured (a control moment counts when one of the outside touches began on it); it is shut until all 32 are
contact_control.gate_why: self-touches: 10 of the 32 control moments the gate judges have been measured (a control moment counts when one of the self-touches began on it); it is shut until all 32 are outside touches: 14 of the 32 control moments the gate judges have been measured (a control moment counts when one of the outside touches began on it); it is shut until all 32 are

synergy.command_size_scope: formed proposals; following_by_author grades full executed tenures

liveness.varying_rule: the share of a layer's units whose output range over the window's samples exceeds one bf16 step at the unit's own size and the widest output below the -3 line; not_varying lists layers under half

scale.pred_err: mean squared distance between the predicted and the actual next vestibular token; 0 = exact, persist_err = the score of predicting no change
scale.improvement_over_persistence: 1 - pred_err / persist_err: 0 = no better than 'nothing changes', 1 = exact, negative = worse
scale.head_tilt_deg: angle of the head from its lying-still-on-the-back orientation, by gravity: 0 = that orientation, 90 = a quarter turn, 180 = upside down
scale.trunk_roll_deg: how far the trunk has rolled from lying on its back, either way: 0 = on the back, 90 = on a side, 180 = face down
scale.trunk_pitch_deg: 0 = trunk horizontal, 90 = head straight up, -90 = head straight down
scale.per_body: the same three per body; trunk_roll_deg there is signed (+ and - are the two sides) and is the direction average over the window
scale.support_trunk: share of outside support carried by the trunk (0-1)
scale.limit_load: share of motor-driven joints within 2.0 degrees of a limit (0-1)
scale.clipped_share: share of real raw values the input bound changed (0 = none). The bound is 4 in each field's own unit: 4 g for the head accelerometer, 4 body weights for support_total, and 4 times the measured 99th percentile for the gyro, neck speeds and the two efforts
scale.lesson_share: the vestibular term's share of the next-moment lesson over the window, at its declared weight (0 = none of the lesson, 1 = all of it; an equal share among five graded senses is 0.2)
scale.input_clipped_share: share of the encoder's centred and scaled inputs that the bound of 4 running spreads changed (0 = none)
scale.input_spread_min: the smallest running spread of any field, in that field's unit, beside the floor it never falls below
scale.input_centre_filled_share: how much of the running mean's 2,000-moment horizon real frames have filled (0 = no real frame yet, 1 = full)
scale.liveness: per hidden layer of the encoder, the share of its units whose input rose above -3 on some moment of the window (0 = a dead layer, 1 = every unit took part)

controllability.gate_why: 32 of the last 32 orders agreed better with what the model expected from the order it sent than with what it would have expected from another body's order (a coin flip gives 16 of 32). The average advantage is 22.8 times its own measurement noise; the gate opens above 3 times and, once open, closes below 1 time. It is open.

scale.persistence_ema: mean squared change of the sense's token between moments; 0 = the token never changes
scale.weight_effective: 1 = as in the plain sum; 2 = the sense counts twice its raw error
scale.share_plain/share_normalized: of every 1.0 of the lesson, the part each sense carries, plain sum vs normalised
scale.ratio: 0 = predicted exactly, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes', above 1 = worse
scale.weight_cap: no sense weighs more than this; measured as the largest weight any sense needed in any 100-step window of H84 segments 30-31
